This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the Masroor Airbase Station in degrees Celsius on 23 Aug '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the Masroor Airbase Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/pk/karachi/OPKC.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader sentiment shows tight uncertainty between 31°C and 32°C maxima for Karachi on August 23, driven by monsoon-season forecast variability. Global and regional models diverge on the timing and extent of cloud cover plus scattered precipitation linked to the monsoon trough, which can reduce solar heating and trigger evaporative cooling that lowers daytime peaks by 1–3°C. Current observational trends and climatological baselines place typical August highs near 32°C, yet active moisture influx often produces localized suppression. Fresh model guidance expected from meteorological agencies over the next 24 hours will clarify steering patterns and rainfall intensity ahead of official verification, potentially tipping the narrow consensus.
